mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, dingtalk_user_id, union_id, name, mobile, email, title, dept_ids, dept_names, sys_dept_id, active, last_sync_time, create_time, update_time, version
mapper.select:
SELECT du.id, du.tenant_id, du.dingtalk_user_id, du.union_id, du.name, du.mobile, du.email, du.title, du.dept_ids, du.dept_names, du.sys_dept_id, du.active, du.last_sync_time, du.create_time, du.update_time, du.version, i.sys_user_id, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.perms = 'crm:access' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS access_granted, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_id ORDER BY r.role_sort) AS role_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_sort SEPARATOR '、') AS role_names, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.perms LIKE 'crm:%' THEN m.perms END ORDER BY m.perms SEPARATOR ',') AS permission_codes FROM crm_dingtalk_directory_user du LEFT JOIN crm_dingtalk_identity i ON i.tenant_id = du.tenant_id AND i.dingtalk_user_id = du.dingtalk_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = i.sys_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = '0' WHERE du.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (du.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR du.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR du.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR du.dept_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY du.id, du.tenant_id, du.dingtalk_user_id, du.union_id, du.name, du.mobile, du.email, du.title, du.dept_ids, du.dept_names, du.sys_dept_id, du.active, du.last_sync_time, du.create_time, du.update_time, du.version, i.sys_user_id
HAVING access_granted = TRUE
HAVING access_granted = FALSE
ORDER BY du.active DESC, du.dept_names, du.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_dingtalk_directory_user ( id, tenant_id, dingtalk_user_id, union_id, name, mobile, email, title, dept_ids, dept_names, sys_dept_id, active, last_sync_time, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{dingtalkUserId}, #{unionId}, #{name}, #{mobile}, #{email}, #{title}, #{deptIds}, #{deptNames}, #{sysDeptId}, #{active}, #{lastSyncTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE union_id = VALUES(union_id), name = VALUES(name), mobile = VALUES(mobile), email = VALUES(email), title = VALUES(title), dept_ids = VALUES(dept_ids), dept_names = VALUES(dept_names), sys_dept_id = VALUES(sys_dept_id), active = VALUES(active), last_sync_time = VALUES(last_sync_time), update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_key AS roleKey, r.role_sort AS roleSort FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' AND m.perms = 'crm:access' ORDER BY r.role_sort

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM crm_dingtalk_identity i JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = i.sys_user_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} AND m.perms = 'crm:access' AND m.status = '0'
